name: W02 · Milestone notifier (webhook from API) → WhatsApp template / email → receipts → 24 h fallback check

nodes.name: Milestone event (from API)
nodes.notes: Called by the Go API for real-time milestones (LL issued, payment pending > 2 h (EC-09), test result entered, licence approved) and by clock.fire_batch for each case-clock batch (W01 → case_clock_sweep). Signed envelope { ts, payload: "<JSON string>", sig: "sha256=<hex hmac(MD_HMAC_SECRET, ts + '.' + payload)>" }. payload = { event, event_id, messages: [OutboundMessage] }. The API has already applied opt-in, quiet hours and the ≤ 1 nudge/day limit (MD-130): every message here is one the API decided to send.

nodes.name: Verify envelope (HMAC)
nodes.notes: Timing-safe compare; 300 s freshness window (same as the API side). Needs `crypto` in Code nodes (n8n Cloud: allowed).

nodes.name: Split + drop duplicate keys
nodes.notes: Keys are `{caseId}:{milestoneId}:{dueOn}:{channel}` (BACKEND.md §7.2). Static data persists for production (active) executions only.

nodes.name: Route by channel
nodes.notes: Routing only. Web push and in-app are sent by the backend itself; they pass straight to receipts.

nodes.name: WhatsApp template
nodes.notes: Meta-approved utility templates only (MD-131): md_ll_issued_v1, md_payment_pending_v1, md_test_result_v1, md_licence_approved_v1, md_ll_day25_v1, md_ll_expiry_t30_v1, md_ll_expiry_t7_v1. Vars are dates/first names computed by the backend; no fee or day literals here (D-06). Fail-message previews carry no outcome words.

nodes.name: Email
nodes.notes: Subject and body are rendered by the backend from reviewed templates (with the non-affiliation footer).

nodes.name: SMS (DISABLED until TRAI DLT registration, MD-623)
nodes.notes: DISABLED ON PURPOSE (D-16, MD-128). No SMS is sent until TRAI DLT entity + template registration (MD-623). The node has no credentials, an .invalid host and no outgoing connection; the backend never emits channel=sms while the tenant flag is off. Enabling it needs a reviewed change, not an n8n edit.

nodes.name: API-66 ack receipts
nodes.notes: Backend marks E-13 Notification rows sent/failed; a failed WhatsApp send makes the backend schedule email/web push. Idempotent by notification_id. Not auto-retried: a retry must be re-signed (replay cache).

nodes.name: Wait 24 h
nodes.notes: Timer only (resumes by time). One execution waits for the whole batch, never one per user (execution budget).

nodes.name: Seen? (backend decides fallback)
nodes.notes: Proposed endpoint (x-proposed; spec text: GET /internal/notifications/{id}/seen, batched here as one signed POST). Response { results: [{ notification_id, action: 'request_fallback' | 'none' }] }. The backend applies opt-in, quiet hours and the nudge limit; n8n only routes on `action`.

nodes.name: API-66 request fallback
nodes.notes: The backend sends the email / web push fallback itself (never SMS, D-16).

main.node: SMS (DISABLED until TRAI DLT registration, MD-623)

margdarshak.business_logic: none (recipients, channel, template, nudge limit, quiet hours and fallback are decided by the backend)
margdarshak.sms: disabled node only, no credentials, no outgoing connection (MD-623)
